## Staples (ADR-170)

The most played: Lightning Bolt 8 · Flametongue Kavu 8 · Restoration Angel 6 · Swords to Plowshares 6 · Child of Night 4 · Doom Blade 4 · Nekrataal 4 · Soul Warden 4.
